entities.name: PDU session release procedure
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure to release a PDU session towards the UE.

entities.name: PDU SESSION INACTIVE PENDING
entities.description: Network state where the network has initiated PDU session release and is waiting for UE response.

entities.name: Waiting for UE response
entities.description: Network condition where it awaits a response from the UE during PDU session release procedure.

relations.description: The PDU SESSION INACTIVE PENDING state occurs during the network-initiated PDU session release procedure.
The state is characterized by the condition of waiting for UE response.
